subject: New rule: AGENTS.md §0 Always collaborate
body: Read AGENTS.md §0 now (commit 2630a122). In short: check status, inbox and the handoff log before starting; build on others' results instead of running a parallel version; keep claims and locks fresh; pull and re-read a shared file right before editing it, and get agreement before removing another agent's committed lines; push verified results promptly; hand off cleanly.
